note: Derived from Figure 1A, which draws the complete reaction 306 + 4 Oi10 -> 306Oi10 with every bond. Built by STRING SUBSTITUTION of four short fragment literals into a tail-first template (make_reference.py): no RWMol, no AddBond, no RemoveAtom, no CombineMols and no RDKit reaction anywhere, so it shares no assembly code with stage03_enumerate.py, which builds every bond through curation/lib assemble.attach from an atom-mapped head. The traversal order is also different on purpose -- the template starts at an isopropyl terminus and walks inward, which RDKit's canonical order does not. WHAT IT TESTS THAT NOTHING ELSE CAN: the SUBSTITUTION COUNT (four tails, two on each primary nitrogen, none on the tertiary one). Formula and exact mass are consequences of that count, not evidence for it. LIMIT: Oi10 is 'isodecyl acrylate', a commercial branched-isomer mixture; the 8-methylnonyl branch is the one the authors DREW, so this anchor inherits that claim rather than testing it, and every Oi10 row in 03_enumerated.csv carries structure_assumed = 1.
